title: Deer holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9b0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd27a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='30' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#c98a5b' transform='rotate(-25 30 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='30' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#c98a5b' transform='rotate(25 70 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='31' rx='3.5' ry='7' fill='#f2c9a0' transform='rotate(-25 30 31)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='31' rx='3.5' ry='7' fill='#f2c9a0' transform='rotate(25 70 31)'/>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M33 22 L28 10 M28 10 L22 8 M28 10 L30 4' stroke='#e8c07a' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M67 22 L72 10 M72 10 L78 8 M72 10 L70 4' stroke='#e8c07a' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#b8733e'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#f2c9a0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#3b2415'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#3b2415'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='41' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='41' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='3.5' ry='2.8' fill='#7a3e1c'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 58 Q50 61 54 58' stroke='#7a3e1c' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#b8733e'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#f2c9a0'/>
  <!-- front legs / arms -->
  <path d='M38 70 Q34 80 36 88' stroke='#b8733e' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M62 70 Q66 80 64 88' stroke='#b8733e' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='88' r='3.5' fill='#7a3e1c'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='88' r='3.5' fill='#7a3e1c'/>
  <!-- heart held between hooves -->
  <path d='M50 70 C44 64 34 66 34 73 C34 79 42 83 50 88 C58 83 66 79 66 73 C66 66 56 64 50 70 Z' fill='#e8446f'/>
  <path d='M50 71 C46 67 40 68 40 72' stroke='#ff9cb8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
</svg>
